titre: La franchise américaine croît encore en 2026
sous_titre: Croissance attendue en 2026 par rapport à 2025, en pourcentage

Production économique.texte: economic output rising by 1.6%, exceeding $920 billion dollars

Emplois.texte: Franchise employment is anticipated to increase by more than 150,000 jobs (1.8%) to nearly 8.9 million jobs.

PIB de la franchise.texte: Total franchise GDP is estimated to grow by 1.8% from $549.9 to $558.4 billion.
